snapshot.note: Repository heads verified through the connected GitHub account; implementation timestamps are older than the workspace snapshot date.

repositories.name: taiwan_brawl_front
repositories.role: 跨平台使用者介面、社交/聊天體驗、遊戲 package 組合與 FCM client；遊戲 package 逐步承接各自的領域規則與版本契約。

repositories.name: taiwan_brawl_back
repositories.role: API、session、社交/聊天、Royale 房間、媒體、FCM 發送與 Flutter Web 靜態站部署。

repositories.name: user_ui_settings
repositories.role: 共用 theme、locale 與 font-scale provider；目前前端以 sibling path dependency 引用。

repositories.name: user_basic_system
repositories.role: 可重用 profile 與 DM chat system abstraction；前端以 package dependency 引用。

repositories.name: taiwan_brawl_core
repositories.role: 共用無平台 runtime configuration；source 位於 taiwan_brawl_front/packages/shared/taiwan_brawl_core，由 frontend repository 版控；敏感 credential、device key 與 provider token 不由此 package 保存。

repositories.name: taiwan_brawl_messaging
repositories.role: 共用 offline-first messaging event、identity/storage ports、projection、outbox 與 transport primitives；source 位於 taiwan_brawl_front/packages/shared/taiwan_brawl_messaging，由 frontend repository 版控；保持 Flutter/Hive/HTTP/WebRTC 無關。
